from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashBalanceRecord(BaseModel):
    """A cash balance record extracted from a single financial filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The registrant company name as stated in the document")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered by the document")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact text label of the cash balance line item")
    balance_amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the cash balance reported")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the amount (e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions')")
    document_quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt from the document containing the amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_balance_records: list[CashBalanceRecord]
